answer:
The delivery condition that must change is delivery confirmation: policy says payout requires delivery confirmation, and the current order timeline for `order-2` shows only `payment_captured`, with no delivery-confirmed event. [evidence:evidence-58d7c4603344] [evidence:evidence-20dc190b3e15]

Also, even after delivery is confirmed, the policy requires a 24-hour hold after delivery before release. [evidence:evidence-58d7c4603344]

Current payout state remains `held`. [evidence:evidence-e94b8076dea3]

evidence-e94b8076dea3.purpose: Current order, return, refund and payout records; allocation amounts repeat across multiple returns
evidence-e94b8076dea3.sql: SELECT i.order_id, i.id AS item_id, i.quantity, r.id AS return_id, r.status AS return_status, r.quantity AS return_quantity, f.id AS refund_id, f.status AS refund_status, f.amount AS refund_amount_paise, a.gross AS gross_paise, a.refunded AS refunded_paise, a.fee AS fee_paise, p.id AS payout_id, p.status AS payout_status, p.amount AS payout_amount_paise FROM analytics.order_items AS i LEFT JOIN analytics.returns AS r ON r.item_id = i.id LEFT JOIN analytics.refunds AS f ON f.return_id = r.id LEFT JOIN analytics.allocations AS a ON a.item_id = i.id LEFT JOIN analytics.payouts AS p ON p.allocation_id = a.id WHERE i.order_id = %(order_id)s ORDER BY i.id, r.id

evidence-20dc190b3e15.purpose: Recorded order event timeline, including failed and successful attempts
evidence-20dc190b3e15.sql: WITH items AS (SELECT id FROM analytics.order_items WHERE order_id = %(order_id)s), return_ids AS (SELECT id FROM analytics.returns WHERE item_id IN (SELECT id FROM items)), allocation_ids AS (SELECT id FROM analytics.allocations WHERE item_id IN (SELECT id FROM items)), related AS (SELECT id FROM analytics.orders WHERE id = %(order_id)s UNION SELECT id FROM items UNION SELECT id FROM return_ids UNION SELECT id FROM allocation_ids UNION SELECT id FROM analytics.refunds WHERE return_id IN (SELECT id FROM return_ids) UNION SELECT id FROM analytics.payouts WHERE allocation_id IN (SELECT id FROM allocation_ids) UNION SELECT id FROM analytics.shipments WHERE item_id IN (SELECT id FROM items) UNION SELECT id FROM analytics.payments WHERE order_id = %(order_id)s) SELECT e.revision, e.kind, e.entity_id, e.details, e.occurred_at, e.recorded_at FROM analytics.events AS e WHERE e.entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM related) OR e.details ->> 'id' IN (SELECT id FROM related) ORDER BY e.revision, e.recorded_at, e.id

evidence-8dc63491090b.purpose: Order and payment summary for the requested order history
evidence-8dc63491090b.sql: SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.status AS order_status, o.created_at, p.status AS payment_status, p.amount AS payment_amount_paise, p.currency FROM analytics.orders AS o LEFT JOIN analytics.payments AS p ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE o.id = %(order_id)s

chunks.title: Settlement policy
chunks.body: Payout requires delivery confirmation and a 24-hour hold after delivery. Requested, approved or received returns block release. A payout failure leaves funds unpaid; retry is a separate operator action. Delivery alone does not imply a completed payout.
